comments.content: This conditionally invokes different custom hooks based on mutable Redux state, violating the Rules of Hooks. If `defaultaides` changes between renders, the hook sequence changes (`useLocalSystemAgents` also calls `useRuntime`), which can trigger a “Rendered more/fewer hooks than expected” error. `store.getState()` also does not subscribe this component to updates. Select `defaultaides` with a Redux selector and use one stable hook sequence, branching inside the effect instead.

The `settings.data.default_aides.*` keys were added only to `zh-cn.json`. The additions to the other locale files use the unrelated key `settings.defaultaides`, so this menu and its form show a raw key or Chinese fallback outside Simplified Chinese. Add `title`, `repo_url`, and `repo_url_placeholder` under `settings.data.default_aides` in the other locales.

This initializes the controlled URL input to the literal text `settings.defaultaides`; `DefaultaidesSettings` renders the value directly and never passes it through `t()`. Consequently, a fresh install displays an internal translation key instead of an empty URL or “Built-in”. Use `null`/`''` as the local-mode sentinel, or explicitly translate the sentinel when rendering it.
